Synthetic support cases for the stub case source (`engine/stubcases`), one
YAML file per case named by its ID. Nothing here comes from a real case.

`00000004.yaml` is a long case: 18 comments written for it, holding the
shapes real case comments take: replies by email with the earlier message
quoted beneath and the same footer each time, two quoted replies, one of a
paragraph one earlier comment holds and one of a paragraph two hold, a
50-line log, an automated comment and the attachments named. The stub source
reads its `authorKind`, `support` or `customer` here and any word a case
system has for an author elsewhere, and `automated` into each comment, and
accepts `synthetic`, the fixture's own provenance mark, which reaches no
comment.
